notes.title: Update June 20
notes.content:
[b]GreenBulb has had a makeover![/b]
In this update, we’ve added a brand-new introductory sequence, enhanced sound playback, refined the menu interface, and improved overall game performance. Interface scaling now works better on larger monitors, and gamepad controls have been updated for more standardized mapping. We’ve also expanded and improved the in-game help content.
